title: Music: Piano
script_notes: Production note: confirm the duet rule before filming. See Booklet issues, item 1.

shots.framing: B-roll: slow push-in on hands over the keys.
shots.camera: Slow push-in on hands over the keys
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: slow push-in on hands over the keys

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: MUSIC
graphics.subtitle: PIANO
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Two to five minutes. One piano. Three judges watching your hands. Let's get you ready.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for pianists.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: There are three piano categories. Sacred Piano. Classical. And new this year, Piano Duet.

graphics.title: 3 CATEGORIES
graphics.subtitle: SACRED · CLASSICAL · DUET (NEW)
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Each school can enter three students per division in Sacred, and three in Classical.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: For duets, it's one per school in Junior High, and one in Senior High.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Your piece has to be sacred or classical.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: And "classical" means the style, not just the Classical era. Popular music doesn't count.

graphics.title: YOUR PIECE
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Movie soundtracks are out too, even the ones that sound classical. Same with Gospel rock, Gospel country, jazz and ragtime.

graphics.title: YOUR PIECE
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Play one piece or one medley, two to five minutes. Too short or too long costs a point per judge.

graphics.title: YOUR PIECE
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Elementary players, you won't lose points for running short.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Here's a big one. Is your classical piece from after 1950? Send it to the head piano judge for approval, at least a month before the competition.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And don't repeat the piece you played last year.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: P1 close-up, leans in

shots.framing: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out
shots.camera: Pages fan out one by one from a stack

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: When you're called, give the judges three copies of your music and three judging sheets.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Published music only. Clear copies, nothing handwritten.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Number every measure. Mark any changes you made to the printed music.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Each one you miss is a point per judge.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Be there at the start of your performance hour, ready to play when they call you.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Introduce yourself, your school, your piece and the composer. Then the timing starts.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: copies and judging sheets fanned out

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Soloists, memorize your piece. If it isn't memorized, it won't be scored.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Duet teams, you don't have to memorize.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: After you play, collect your copies. Anything left behind gets tossed.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Pick the right piece.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Number every measure.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And memorize it.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
